from collections import defaultdict,Counter
species_files={'human':'human.paf','mouse':'mouse.paf','pig':'pig.paf'}
best={}  # read -> sp -> (score,nmatch,alen)
for sp,fn in species_files.items():
    with open(fn) as f:
        for line in f:
            p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            q=p[0]; qlen=int(p[1]); qs=int(p[2]); qe=int(p[3]); nm=int(p[9]); alen=int(p[10]); mapq=int(p[11])
            if alen < 45 or nm/alen < 0.84: continue
            # score favor longer/high identity hits; subtract mismatches approximately
            score=2*nm-alen
            d=best.setdefault(q,{})
            if sp not in d or score>d[sp][0]:
                d[sp]=(score,nm,alen)
print('reads any',len(best))
for gap in [1,2,3,5,8,10,15,20]:
  for ratio in [0.75,0.8,0.9]:
    bc=defaultdict(Counter)
    read_assign=Counter()
    for q,d in best.items():
        items=sorted(((v[0],sp,v[1],v[2]) for sp,v in d.items()), reverse=True)
        top=items[0]
        second=items[1][0] if len(items)>1 else -999
        if top[0] >= second + gap and top[2] >=50: # nm >=50
            sp=top[1]; cb=q.split('|')[1]
            bc[cb][sp]+=1; read_assign[sp]+=1
    assigned=[]; amb=0; low=0
    for cb,c in bc.items():
        tot=sum(c.values())
        if tot<20: low+=1; continue
        sp,n=c.most_common(1)[0]; frac=n/tot
        if frac>=ratio:
            assigned.append(sp)
        else: amb+=1
    cnt=Counter(assigned); total=len(assigned)
    print('gap',gap,'ratio',ratio,'read_assign',dict(read_assign),'bc_assigned',total,'amb',amb,'low',low,'species',dict(cnt),'pct',{s: (cnt[s]/total*100 if total else 0) for s in ['human','mouse','pig']})
  print()

            d=best.setdefault(q,{})
            if sp not in d or score>d[sp][0]:
                d[sp]=(score,nm,alen,gene)
# read-level assignment
gap=10
read_sp={}
read_gene={}
bc_counts=defaultdict(Counter)
for q,d in best.items():
    items=sorted(((v[0],sp,v[1],v[2],v[3]) for sp,v in d.items()), reverse=True)

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import collections, gzip
markers = {
'liver':'ALB TTR APOA1 APOA2 FGA FGB FGG APOB HP KNG1 SERPINA1 ASGR1 CYP2E1 CYP2D6',
'heart':'MYH6 MYH7 TNNT2 TNNI3 ACTC1 MYL2 MYL3 TPM1 NPPA NPPB PLN',
'testis':'PRM1 PRM2 PRM3 TNP1 TNP2 DDX4 DAZL SYCP3 ACRV1 ZPBP ODF1 ODF2 TEX101',
'kidney':'UMOD SLC12A1 SLC34A1 SLC5A2 LRP2 CUBN AQP1 AQP2 NPHS1 NPHS2 PODXL KCNJ1',
'bone_marrow':'HBB HBA1 HBA2 HBD HBM AHSP ALAS2 GYPA SLC25A37 CA1 BLVRB HBG1 HBG2 HBE1',
'spleen':'PTPRC CD74 MS4A1 CD79A CD79B LYZ LST1 C1QA C1QB C1QC NKG7 GNLY',
'cortex':'SNAP25 RBFOX3 SLC17A7 GAD1 GAD2 MBP PLP1 SLC1A2 GFAP AQP4 TUBB3',
'retina':'RHO GNAT1 PDE6B SAG RCVRN CRX OPN1SW OPN1MW ARR3 GNGT1',
'lung':'SCGB1A1 SFTPA1 SFTPA2 SFTPB SFTPC SFTPD AGER FOXJ1 EPCAM WFDC2',
'skin':'KRT14 KRT5 KRT1 KRT10 KRT15 COL17A1 FLG LOR IVL DSP'
}
# build read_to_bc and gene counts from PAF as in summary
read_to_bc={}
with gzip.open('three.way.barnyard.q2.R1.fq.gz','rt') as f:
  while True:
    h=f.readline()
    if not h: break
    s=f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); f.readline()
    read_to_bc[h[1:].split()[0].rsplit('/',1)[0]]=s[:16]
best={}
with open('r2_vs_cdna.paf') as f:
  for line in f:
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    q=p[0].rsplit('/',1)[0]; aln=int(p[10]); mapq=int(p[11]); matches=int(p[9]); qspan=int(p[3])-int(p[2])
    if aln<45 or qspan<45: continue
    score=(mapq,matches,aln)
    if q not in best or score>best[q][0]:
      sp,gene,*_=p[5].split('|',2); best[q]=(score,sp,gene)
sg=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for q,(_,sp,gene) in best.items(): sg[sp][gene.upper()]+=1
for sp in ['human','mouse','pig']:
  print('##',sp)
  for tissue, genes in markers.items():
    total=sum(sg[sp][g] for g in genes.split())
    hits=[(g,sg[sp][g]) for g in genes.split() if sg[sp][g]]
    print(tissue,total,hits[:20])
PY"

                    h=line[1:].strip()
                    tid=h.split()[0]
                    gene=re.search(r'gene:(["'^'"\\s]+)',h)

                    description=desc.group(1) if desc else ''
                    new=f'{sp}|{tid}'
                    fo.write(f'>{new}\\n')
                    tg.write('\\t'.join([new,sp,gene_id,symbol,description])+'\\n')
                else:
                    fo.write(line)
print(os.path.getsize(out), os.path.getsize(t2g))
PY

    for line in f:
        tid,sp,gene,sym,desc=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        target[tid]=(sp,sym,desc)
sp_counts=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.Counter())
sp_gene_reads=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
sp_gene_umis=collections.defaultdict(set)
read_sp_total=collections.Counter()
used=0; skipped=0
readno_re=re.compile(r'READ_(\\d+)')
with open('cds_primary.paf') as f:
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        qname=p[0]; qlen=int(p[1]); qstart=int(p[2]); qend=int(p[3]); tid=p[5]
        matches=int(p[9]); aln=int(p[10]); mapq=int(p[11])
        if aln < 45 or matches / max(aln,1) < 0.88:

        m=readno_re.match(qname)

    if not m: return

    best_sp={}; best_gene={}
    for sp,score,sym in hits:

---
name: galaxy-tool-submission
description: Use for Galaxy submissions with nested, repeated, conditional, paired, collection, or reference-selector inputs, when raw API payload binding is uncertain, or when staging a large public or reference artifact into a Galaxy history. Skip simple submissions handled by a validating client.
---

# Galaxy Tool Submission

Use this skill after the scientific tool and parameters have been selected. Build
complex inputs from the selected wrapper's live schema and verify the created job
resolved the intended objects.

## Dataset Inputs

- Wait for uploaded data to reach `ok` with the expected datatype before using
  the final history dataset ID.
- Verify paired mates use distinct dataset IDs and preserve forward/reverse
  order.
- For reference-source conditionals, confirm the job resolved the intended
  history reference or built-in genome rather than a default branch.

## Large Public Or Reference Objects

- Stage an authoritative public or refere

#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Galaxy UDT Authoring

Use this skill for UDT execution mechanics. It does not prescribe what a UDT
should compute or how its outputs should be interpreted.

## Workflow

1. Map the program or command to its Galaxy inputs, output files, runtime, and
   resource needs.
2. Find and verify a live pinned runtime that contains the required
   implementation.
3. Author a clear `GalaxyUserTool` representation for the intended program.
   Combine stages only when no intermediate result can change, reject, or
   invalidate a downstream stage. Otherwise run the diagnostic or prerequisite
   first, or make the command stop before do

# Galaxy UDT Implementation Reference

Read only the section needed for the current implementation or failure.

- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)
- [Staged generated script](#staged-generated-script)
- [Short base64 fallback](#short-base64-fallback)
- [Resource fields](#resource-fields)
- [Execution failures](#execution-failures)

The YAML blocks are authoring examples. The API representation may be serialized
as JSON.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  application-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

species_map = {

                m_sym=re.search(r'gene_symbol:(\\S+)',header)

                sym=m_sym.group(1) if m_sym else gene_id

import gzip, os, re
from collections import defaultdict
species_map = {
 'Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz': 'human',
 'Mus_musculus.GRCm39.cdna.all.fa.gz': 'mouse',
 'Sus_scrofa.Sscrofa11.1.cdna.all.fa.gz': 'pig',
}
for fn,sp in species_map.items():
    out_fa = 'refs/'+sp+'_longest.fa'
    out_tg = 'refs/'+sp+'_longest_tgmap.tsv'
    best={}  # gene_key -> (tid,seq,gene_id,sym)
    tid=None; gene_id=None; sym=None; seq=[]
    def flush():
        global tid,gene_id,sym,seq
        if tid:
            s=''.join(seq)
            key=gene_id
            if key not in best or len(s)>len(best[key][1]):
                best[key]=(tid,s,gene_id,sym)
    with gzip.open('refs/'+fn,'rt') as fin:
        for line in fin:
            if line.startswith('>'):
                flush(); tid=None; seq=[]
                header=line[1:].strip()
                if 'gene_biotype:protein_coding' not in header:
                    continue
                tid=header.split()[0]
                m_gene=re.search(r'gene:(\\S+)',header)
                m_sym=re.search(r'gene_symbol:(\\S+)',header)
                gene_id=m_gene.group(1) if m_gene else tid
                sym=m_sym.group(1) if m_sym else gene_id
            elif tid is not None:
                seq.append(line.strip())
        flush()
    with open(out_fa,'w') as fo, open(out_tg,'w') as tg:
        for key,(t,s,g,sym) in best.items():
            gene_key=f'{sp.upper()}__{g}__{sym}'
            fo.write('>'+t+'\\n')
            for i in range(0,len(s),80):
                fo.write(s[i:i+80]+'\\n')
            tg.write(f'{t}\\t{gene_key}\\n')
    print(sp,'genes',len(best),'size',os.path.getsize(out_fa),'tg',os.path.getsize(out_tg))

Use this skill for UDT execution mechanics. It does not prescribe what a UDT
should compute or how its outputs should be interpreted.

## Workflow

1. Map the program or command to its Galaxy inputs, output files, runtime, and

2. Find and verify a live pinned runtime that contains the required
   implementation.
3. Author a clear `GalaxyUserTool` representation for the intended program.

   invalidate a downstream stage. Otherwise run the diagnostic or prerequisite
   first, or make the command stop before do

Read only the section needed for the current implementation or failure.

- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)
- [Staged generated script](#staged-generated-script)
- [Short base64 fallback](#short-base64-fallback)

The YAML blocks are authoring examples. The API representation may be serialized
as JSON.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  application-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

inputs:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import gzip, re, pickle, sys

def main():
    path = "refs/all.cds.fa"
    info = {}
    gene_re = re.compile(r'gene:([^ ]+)')
    sym_re = re.compile(r'gene_symbol:([^ ]+)')
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        header = None
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith(">"):
                header = line[1:].strip()
                if "|" not in header:
                    continue
                sp, name = header.split("|", 1)
                m = sym_re.search(header)
                sym = m.group(1) if m else ""
                m2 = gene_re.search(header)
                gene = m2.group(1) if m2 else ""
                info[name] = (sp, sym, gene)
    with open("refs/ref_info.pkl", "wb") as out:
        pickle.dump(info, out)
    print(f"wrote {len(info)} entries")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import gzip, collections
raw=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
umi=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(set))
with gzip.open('read_assign.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        bc, u, sp, gene, gid = line.rstrip().split('\\t')
        raw[bc][sp]+=1
        umi[bc][u].add(sp)
print('barcodes',len(raw))
for thresh in [0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95,1.0]:
    counts=collections.Counter(); ambiguous=0; unassigned_total=0
    for bc,c in raw.items():
        total=sum(c.values())
        # umi species counts unique UMI
        sp_umi=collections.Counter()
        for u,species in umi[bc].items():
            if len(species)==1:
                sp_umi[next(iter(species))]+=1
        tot=sum(sp_umi.values())
        if tot==0:
            unassigned_total+=1; continue
        top_sp, top=sp_umi.most_common(1)[0]
        if top/tot>=thresh:
            counts[top_sp]+=1
        else:
            ambiguous+=1
    print('thresh',thresh,'counts',counts,'ambig',ambiguous,'noUmi',unassigned_total,'pct', {k:round(v/sum(counts.values())*100) for k,v in counts.items()})
# distribution raw species fractions per barcode
print('top species by raw:')
raw_counts=collections.Counter()
for bc,c in raw.items():
    sp=c.most_common(1)[0][0]; raw_counts[sp]+=1
print(raw_counts)

# total reads per bc
total=Counter()
with open('work/read_barcodes.tsv') as f:

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
bc_list=[]
with open('read_barcodes.tsv') as f:
    for l in f: bc_list.append(l.rstrip().split('\\t')[1])
barcodes=sorted(set(bc_list)); bidx={b:i for i,b in enumerate(barcodes)}; ridx=np.array([bidx[b] for b in bc_list],dtype=np.int32)
h=np.load('human_scores.npy');m=np.load('mouse_scores.npy');p=np.load('pig_scores.npy')
S=np.vstack([h,m,p]).T; order=np.argsort(-S,axis=1); best=S[np.arange(len(S)),order[:,0]]; second=S[np.arange(len(S)),order[:,1]]
# choose margin 2, min score 20
assign=np.full(len(S),-1,dtype=np.int8); ok=(best>=20)&(best-second>=2); assign[ok]=order[ok,0]
counts=np.zeros((len(barcodes),3),dtype=np.int32); valid=assign>=0; np.add.at(counts,(ridx[valid],assign[valid]),1)
total=counts.sum(axis=1); top=counts.argmax(axis=1); topc=counts.max(axis=1)
conf=(total>=100)&(topc/total>=0.9)
print('conf',conf.sum(),Counter(top[conf]))
# load gene counts per species
for sp,file in [(0,'human_run_human_gene_by_bc.tsv'),(1,'mouse_run2_mouse_gene_by_bc.tsv'),(2,'pig_combined_pig_gene_by_bc.tsv')]:

        for l in f:
            b,g,c=l.rstrip().split('\\t'); gene[b][g]+=int(c)
    sel=[barcodes[i] for i in np.where(conf & (top==sp))[0]]
    agg=Counter()
    for b in sel: agg.update(gene[b])
    print('\\nSpecies',sp,'n',len(sel),'top genes:')
    print(agg.most_common(60))
    print('sel top barcodes',sel[:20])

import sys, gzip, re, json, collections, os

# build barcode dict from R1
r1_path='three.way.barnyard.q2.R1.fq.gz'
bc={}  # readid -> (barcode, umi)
with gzip.open(r1_path,'rt') as f:
    while True:
        h=f.readline()
        if not h: break
        seq=f.readline().rstrip('\\n')
        plus=f.readline()
        qual=f.readline()
        rid=h[1:].split()[0]
        base=rid
        if base.endswith('/1'): base=base[:-2]
        bc[base]=(seq[:16], seq[16:28])

# build transcript->gene from combined fasta (stream)
print('building gene map', file=sys.stderr)
gene={}
with open('combined.cdna.fa','rt') as f:
    tid=None
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('>'):
            tid=line[1:].split()[0]
            m=re.search(r'gene_symbol:(["'^ ]+)'"', line)
            gene[tid]=m.group(1) if m else ''
# Note tid already has prefix HUMAN_ etc; store full.
print('gene map', len(gene), file=sys.stderr)

species_counts=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.Counter())
# also raw species gene read counts aggregated
species_gene_reads=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.Counter())
# per-barcode per-species gene UMI counts for later maybe
# We'll aggregate gene reads per species and UMI sets per barcode per species
umi_sets=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(set))) # species->barcode->gene->set(umi)
unmapped=0
mapped=0
unknown=0
for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.startswith('@'): continue
    parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(parts)<10: continue
    flag=int(parts[1])
    if flag & 4:
        unmapped+=1
        continue
    qname=parts[0]
    base=qname
    if base.endswith('/2'): base=base[:-2]
    rname=parts[2]
    species=rname.split('_',1)[0]
    if species not in ('HUMAN','MOUSE','PIG'):
        unknown+=1
        continue
    tid=rname
    g=gene.get(tid,'')
    b=bc.get(base)
    if b is None:
        continue
    barcode, umi=b
    mapped+=1
    species_counts[barcode][species]+=1
    if g:
        species_gene_reads[species][g]+=1
        umi_sets[species][barcode][g].add(umi)

print(f'mapped {mapped} unmapped {unmapped} unknown {unknown}', file=sys.stderr)
# output barcode species assignment based on max mapped read count
with open('barcode_species.tsv','w') as out:
    for barcode, cnt in species_counts.items():
        total=sum(cnt.values())
        best_species, best_count=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
        frac=best_count/total if total else 0
        out.write(f'{barcode}\\t{total}\\t{best_species}\\t{best_count}\\t{frac:.4f}\\t' + '\\t'.join(f'{s}:{cnt.get(s,0)}' for s in ['HUMAN','MOUSE','PIG']) + '\\n')
# save json for gene counts
json.dump({s:dict(c) for s,c in species_gene_reads.items()}, open('species_gene_reads.json','w'))
# save UMI gene counts per species: species->gene->total UMI across cells? We need per cell later. Save gene count per barcode aggregated UMI counts.
with open('species_barcode_gene_umi.tsv','w') as out:
    for sp in ['HUMAN','MOUSE','PIG']:
        d=umi_sets.get(sp,{})
        for barcode, genes in d.items():
            for g, umiset in genes.items():
                out.write(f'{sp}\\t{barcode}\\t{g}\\t{len(umiset)}\\n')

Use this skill for UDT execution mechanics. It does not prescribe what a UDT
should compute or how its outputs should be interpreted.

## Workflow

1. Map the program or command to its Galaxy inputs, output files, runtime, and
   resource needs.
2. Find and verify a live pinned runtime that contains the required
   implementation.
3. Author a clear `GalaxyUserTool` representation for the intended program.

   invalidate a downstream stage. Otherwise run the diagnostic or prerequisite
   first, or make the command stop before do

# Galaxy UDT Implementation Reference

Read only the section needed for the current implementation or failure.

- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)
- [Staged generated script](#staged-generated-script)
- [Short base64 fallback](#short-base64-fallback)
- [Resource fields](#resource-fields)

The YAML blocks are authoring examples. The API representation may be serialized
as JSON.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  application-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

Rscript "$(inputs.script.path)" \

  metadata.tsv \

# Galaxy UDT Implementation Reference

Read only the section needed for the current implementation or failure.

- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)
- [Staged generated script](#staged-generated-script)
- [Short base64 fallback](#short-base64-fallback)
- [Resource fields](#resource-fields)
- [Execution failures](#execution-failures)

The YAML blocks are authoring examples. The API representation may be serialized
as JSON.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

Use this skill after the scientific tool and parameters have been selected. Build
complex inputs from the selected wrapper's live schema and verify the created job

# Galaxy UDT Implementation Reference

Read only the section needed for the current implementation or failure.

- [Minimal UDT](#minimal-udt)
- [Staged generated script](#staged-generated-script)
- [Short base64 fallback](#short-base64-fallback)
- [Resource fields](#resource-fields)

The YAML blocks are authoring examples. The API representation may be serialized
as JSON.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu

import collections,math
# robust pig cells labels from read_scores
lab=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
with gzip.open('read_scores.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
 next(f)
 for line in f:
  x=line.rstrip().split('\\t'); bc=x[1]; v=[int(x[2]),int(x[3]),int(x[4])]; a=sorted(v,reverse=True); sp=['hs','mm','ss'][v.index(a[0])]
  if a[0]>a[1]: lab[bc][sp]+=1
labels={bc:max(c,key=c.get) for bc,c in lab.items() if max(c.values())/sum(c.values())>=.8}
G=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
with open('gene_counts.tsv') as f:
 next(f)
 for line in f:
  bc,sp,g,n=line.rstrip().split('\\t');
  if labels.get(bc)=='ss' and sp=='ss': G[bc][g]+=int(n)
# top genes in groups; score mean log1p count
for group,bs in [('CD80high',[b for b,c in G.items() if c['CD80']>=5]),('CD80zero',[b for b,c in G.items() if c['CD80']==0]),('testishigh',[b for b,c in G.items() if c['PRM1']+c['TNP1']+c['TNP2']+c['PRM2']>=5])]:
 print('\\nGROUP',group,'n',len(bs))
 score=[]
 for g in set().union(*(G[b] for b in bs)):
  if g=='NA' or g.startswith('RPL') or g.startswith('RPS') or g.startswith('COX') or g.startswith('ND') or g in {'ATP6','CYTB','TMEM186','TMSB10','PHKB','ZCCHC24'}: continue
  val=sum(math.log1p(G[b][g]) for b in bs)/len(bs)
  det=sum(G[b][g]>0 for b in bs)
  score.append((val,det,g,sum(G[b][g] for b in bs)))
 for v,d,g,n in sorted(score,reverse=True)[:80]: print(f'{g}\\tavglog={v:.3f}\\tdet={d}/{len(bs)}\\tcount={n}')

import csv
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
with open('cell_species_compare.tsv') as f:
    cr=csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\\t')
    lab={}
    for r in cr:
        v={s:int(r[s+'_margin10']) for s in ('human','mouse','pig')}
        lab[r['barcode']]=max(v,key=v.get)
with open('cell_markers.tsv') as f:
    rd=csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\\t')
    rows=list(rd)
for r in rows:
    h=sum(int(r.get('human_'+g,0)) for g in ('HBB','HBA1','HBA2','HBD','AHSP','ALAS2','CA1','SLC25A37','HBM'))
    m=sum(int(r.get('mouse_'+g,0)) for g in ('SCGB1A1','SFTPC','SFTPA1','SFTPB','SFTPA2','KRT8','KRT18','EPCAM'))
    p=sum(int(r.get('pig_'+g,0)) for g in ('PRM1','PRM2','TNP1','TNP2','DDX4','DAZL','SYCP3','CRISP2','AKAP4','SPAG6','DDX25'))
    r['hs']=h;r['ms']=m;r['ps']=p
print('current label counts',Counter(lab.values()))
print('marker dominant counts',Counter(max((r['hs'],'human'),(r['ms'],'mouse'),(r['ps'],'pig'))[1] for r in rows))
print('label vs marker')
co=Counter((lab[r['barcode']],max((r['hs'],'human'),(r['ms'],'mouse'),(r['ps'],'pig'))[1]) for r in rows)
for x in sorted(co):print(x,co[x])
for s in ('human','mouse','pig'):
    rs=[r for r in rows if lab[r['barcode']]==s]
    print('\\n',s,len(rs),'marker sums',sum(r['hs'] for r in rs),sum(r['ms'] for r in rs),sum(r['ps'] for r in rs))
    for r in sorted(rs,key=lambda x:(x['hs']+x['ms']+x['ps']),reverse=True)[:5]: print(r['barcode'],r['hs'],r['ms'],r['ps'],r['total_reads'])
print('marker low/dominance sorted')
for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda x:max(x['hs'],x['ms'],x['ps']))[:30]: print(lab[r['barcode']],r['barcode'],r['hs'],r['ms'],r['ps'],r['total_reads'])
PY"

   for line in f:

     tid=line[1:].split()[0];key=sp+'|'+tid

     meta[key]={'species':sp,**fields,'description':line.split('description:')[-1].strip()}
     out.write('>'+key+'\\n');n+=1

 if mq>=10 and match/aln>=0.95:
  strict[bi,si]+=1;high_umis[(bi,sp,gene)].add(read_umi[rid])

print('ALIGNMENTS',quality)
for cname,arr in [('all',counts),('strict',strict)]:
 for thresh in [0.7,0.8,0.9,0.95]:
  selected=(arr.max(axis=1)/np.maximum(1,arr.sum(axis=1))>=thresh)&(arr.sum(axis=1)>=20)
  cnt=collections.Counter(np.array(species)[arr[selected].argmax(axis=1)])

with open('results/barcode_species.tsv','w') as f:
 f.write('barcode\\thuman\\tmouse\\tpig\\tstrict_human\\tstrict_mouse\\tstrict_pig\\tassignment\\tfraction\\n')
 for bi,bc in enumerate(barcodes):

 with open('"'results/gene_counts_'+label+'.tsv','w') as f:

  for (sp,gene),num in agg.most_common():f.write(f'{sp}\\t{gene}\\t{num}\\t{cells[(sp,gene)]}\\n')
 print('\\n',label)
 for sp in species:
  print('\\n',sp)
  print([(g,num,cells[(s,g)]) for (s,g),num in agg.most_common() if s==sp][:100])
with gzip.open('results/cell_gene_umis.tsv.gz','wt') as f:
 f.write('barcode\\tspecies\\tgene\\tumis\\n')
 for (bi,sp,g),us in umis.items():f.write(f'{barcodes[bi]}\\t{sp}\\t{g}\\t{len(us)}\\n')
